new_this_week.title: Exposure to polyethylene terephthalate nanoplastics elicits renal injury with limited compensation and associated intestinal alterations: A time-resolved multi-omics study.
new_this_week.summary: Fourteen days of oral PET nanoplastics caused time resolved renal injury in mice with intestinal alterations, constrained by antioxidant compensation.

new_this_week.title: Undiseased and diseased abdominal aortas contain environmentally relevant micronanoplastics.
new_this_week.summary: Environmentally relevant micro and nanoplastics were detected in undiseased and diseased abdominal aortas, adding to evidence they accumulate in atherosclerotic lesions.

new_this_week.title: Co-exposure to octocrylene and polystyrene nanoplastics induces neuro- and reproductive toxicity in zebrafish: Association with circadian rhythm and HPG axis disruption.
new_this_week.summary: Nanoplastic co-exposure with a UV filter worsened zebrafish neuro and reproductive toxicity, through circadian and HPG axis disruption.

new_this_week.title: Early-Life Polyethylene Microplastic Exposure Exacerbates ADHD-Like Behaviors in Mice via PI3K/AKT1/Nrf2 Signaling: Evidence From the Pilot Cohort and Multi-Omics Analyses.
new_this_week.summary: Early polyethylene microplastic exposure worsened ADHD-like behaviour in mice through PI3K/AKT1/Nrf2 signalling, linked to blood burden in children.

new_this_week.title: Brain metabolomics reveals metabolic alterations associated with chronic polystyrene microplastic-induced neurotoxicity in Drosophila melanogaster.
new_this_week.summary: Chronic dietary polystyrene microplastics caused brain metabolic alterations and neurotoxicity in fruit flies, with metabolomics revealing the pathology.

new_this_week.title: Reducing microplastic exposure before clinical cardiovascular intervention is required: a call for a policy-based approach.
new_this_week.summary: Call for a policy-based approach to reducing microplastic exposure in the hours before clinical cardiovascular intervention.

new_this_week.title: From inert to uncertain: Polypropylene mesh degradation and the microplastics question - a narrative review of the literature.
new_this_week.summary: Review of polypropylene mesh degradation after hernia repair and the microplastic debris it generates, in the context of autoimmune disease risk.

new_this_week.title: Microplastics and human health: exposure pathways, toxicological evidence and mitigation strategies.
new_this_week.summary: Review of microplastic exposure pathways, toxicological evidence and mitigation strategies in human health.

new_this_week.title: Unveiling the mechanism of microplastic-mediated antibiotic bioavailability, gut microbiota and antibiotic resistome in marine fish: Importance of microplastic aging and antibiotic-loading.
new_this_week.summary: Environmental ageing and antibiotic loading changed microplastic carrier effects and the antibiotic resistome in marine fish.

new_this_week.title: Detoxification-associated polyvinyl chloride micro- and nanoplastics clearance and liver metabolomic responses in mice.
new_this_week.summary: Aged polyvinyl chloride micro and nanoplastics cleared faster from mouse organs than original particles, with liver metabolic changes.

new_this_week.title: Hypothesis-generating network toxicology analysis of potential molecular convergence between a polystyrene oligomer proxy and papillary thyroid carcinoma.
new_this_week.summary: Network toxicology compared a polystyrene oligomer proxy with papillary thyroid carcinoma gene expression, identifying BCL2, BAX and fibronectin as nodes.

new_this_week.title: Pharmaceutical-derived microplastics: sources, detection, and toxicological implications for patient safety.
new_this_week.summary: Review of pharmaceutical-derived microplastics, their detection and the toxicological implications for patient safety.

new_this_week.title: Nanoplastics as Hepatic Toxicant Vectors: Interactions with Environmental Chemicals, Organelle Dysfunction, and Regulated Cell Death.
new_this_week.summary: Review of nanoplastic hepatotoxicity, interactions with environmental chemicals and the organelle and cell death mechanisms involved.

new_this_week.title: Mapping the biological effects of micro- and nanoplastics in mammalian intestinal models: a scoping review.
new_this_week.summary: Scoping review mapping the biological effects of micro and nanoplastics across mammalian intestinal models.

new_this_week.title: The combined toxicity of polystyrene microplastics and glyphosate on Daphnia magna: Physiological and behavioral responses.
new_this_week.journal: Comp Biochem Physiol C Toxicol Pharmacol
new_this_week.summary: Polystyrene microplastics with glyphosate produced physiological and behavioural toxicity in Daphnia magna.

new_this_week.title: Chronic polystyrene microplastic exposure worsens cognitive dysfunction and Alzheimer's Disease-like neuropathology in APP/PS1 mice.
new_this_week.summary: Six months of 1 micrometre polystyrene microplastics worsened cognitive dysfunction and Alzheimer's-like neuropathology in APP/PS1 mice.

new_this_week.title: Micro- and nanoplastics in gastric cancer: A narrative review.
new_this_week.summary: Narrative review of micro and nanoplastics in gastric cancer, covering mechanisms, H. pylori interaction and experimental evidence.

new_this_week.title: Quercetin attenuates polystyrene nanoplastic-induced intestinal barrier injury through modulation of macrophage inflammatory responses.
new_this_week.summary: Quercetin attenuated polystyrene nanoplastic-induced intestinal barrier injury in mice through modulation of macrophage inflammatory responses.

new_this_week.title: Surface Chemistry Shapes Nanoplastic Mixture Responses in Developing Amniote Embryos.
new_this_week.summary: Surface chemistry shaped nanoplastic mixture responses in developing amniote embryos, with oppositely charged particles altering brain gene and protein covariance.

new_this_week.title: 14C-Enabled Quantitative Fate Mapping of Orally Administered Polystyrene Nanoplastics in Laying Hens.
new_this_week.summary: Quantitative fate mapping showed orally administered polystyrene nanoplastics distributed across laying hens' tissues and retained in eggs.

new_this_week.title: Microplastics and the Kidney: A Narrative Review of Human Evidence, Molecular Mechanisms of Cell Injury, and Future Directions.
new_this_week.summary: Narrative review of human evidence, molecular mechanisms and future directions for microplastic injury to the kidney.

new_this_week.title: Polymer-specific nanoplastic exposure, mitochondrial dysfunction, and depressed ejection fraction in humans.
new_this_week.summary: Blood levels of polystyrene and polyethylene were associated with lower left ventricular ejection fraction in older adults, with polymer-specific mitochondrial dysfunction in human cells.

new_this_week.title: Vickeline NambaBisfenol A, bisfenol F e DEHP remodel the transcriptome of a human 3D placenta model.
new_this_week.summary: Bisphenols A and F and DEHP remodelled the transcriptome of a human 3D placental model at low concentrations.

new_this_week.title: Microplastic-induced female reproductive toxicity: Mechanisms and potential protective interventions.
new_this_week.summary: Review of microplastic mechanisms for female reproductive toxicity and candidate protective interventions.

new_this_week.title: Do nanoplastics reshape microglial support of neuronal resilience? A study of microglial bioenergetics and microglia-neuron communication in vitro.
new_this_week.summary: Nanoplastic exposure reshaped microglial support of neuronal resilience in vitro through nuclear factor erythroid 2-like 2 pathway.

new_this_week.title: Size-Associated Partitioning of Oral Polystyrene Particles Between Intestinal Capillaries and Lacteals Determines Systemic and Lymph Node Distribution in Mice.
new_this_week.summary: Polystyrene particles of different sizes partitioned between intestinal capillaries and lacteals, with larger particles reaching mesenteric lymph nodes and inflamed nodes.

new_this_week.title: Navigating the Nonylphenol Hazard: Insights into Toxicity Mechanisms and Mitigation Approaches.
new_this_week.summary: Review of nonylphenol toxicity mechanisms and mitigation approaches, covering endocrine disruption across multiple organ systems.

new_this_week.title: Effects of Photoaged Polyethylene Microplastics on Cardiac Injury and Fibrosis-like Remodeling in Zebrafish.
new_this_week.summary: Photoaged polyethylene microplastics injured the zebrafish heart and drove fibrosis-like remodelling, a modification confirmed in pristine particles.

new_this_week.title: Ferro-Immuno-Structural Axis (FISA): Kidney specific microplastic toxicity via TLR18 centric immunosuppression and iron dyshomeostasis in rainbow trout.
new_this_week.journal: Comp Biochem Physiol Part D Genomics Proteomics
new_this_week.summary: Microplastic exposure produced kidney-specific toxicity in rainbow trout through toll-like receptor centred immunosuppression and iron dyshomeostasis.

new_this_week.title: Tissue-specific microplastic burdens in humans: An intra-individual mapping of 18 tissue types.
new_this_week.summary: First intra-individual mapping of 18 human tissue types documented tissue-specific microplastic burdens across ten donors.

new_this_week.title: Sputum microplastic concentrations and their association with underweight in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: first human evidence combined with integrated network toxicology analysis.
new_this_week.summary: Pyrolysis gas chromatography mass spectrometry measured 13 polymer types in sputum of 40 COPD patients, with PVC associated underweight and lower fat mass.
